notes: Your buddy now sends Gemini the actual recording of what you say, so it listens to you itself instead of trusting voice typing.
Your buddy now uses every one of his sounds when you call him hands-free (it was stuck on 3), and sounds play like a shuffled deck so each one comes up before any repeat.
Tapping the “Listening” notification now takes you straight to the switch that hides it for good, and swiping it away keeps it away.
Your buddy lines now match by sound, word by word: “call or ponds” or “col my pons” count as “call my pawns”.
Your buddy understands your buddy lines much better: voice typing now expects them, close-sounding words still count, and Gemini catches the badly misheard ones.

Your buddy now always uses online Gemini (no more offline answers), asks again instead of guessing when he mishears, his GIF moves in the pop-up, and Settings has a one-tap way to hide the Listening notification.
Fixed a crash in the hands-free buddy, the crash log shows much more detail, the listening notification is gone, and new Buddy lines in Settings let you teach him your own answers.
Your buddy waits for you to start talking after his sound and answers back if you only say his name, stops listening on Battery saver, and his listening notification stays out of the way.
What you ask your buddy out loud is now written down by Google's voice typing (much more accurate, still no beep), and just saying his name can wake him once he knows your voice.
New crash log in Settings → App updates, and the Work and Classes lists let you set your phone to vibrate or mute during every shift or class.
Your buddy hears his wake phrase much more easily again, and a buddy can have several phrases split by commas.

Only listen to my voice (Settings → Hands-free buddy), buddy answers wait in the app with a dot instead of notifications, Settings no longer closes dropdowns or keeps the keyboard up, and the permissions list only pops up when you have an alarm.
Your buddy double-checks his wake phrase before popping up, hears names like Macca better, and waits longer for you to finish talking (Settings → Hands-free buddy).
Your buddy now starts listening the moment you say his phrase (no beep) and his GIF plays; checked-off reminders leave Overdue, and Clear completed keeps repeating ones.
Events can repeat now: tell your buddy you have class every Monday, Wednesday and Friday until Christmas, or pick Repeat when adding an event.
Your buddy now makes his sound when you call him by voice, and Settings shows a battery tracker for hands-free listening. Tap Install to get it.
Hands-free buddy: give each buddy a wake phrase in his theme, turn it on in Settings, and call him like Siri. Tap Install to get it.
Your buddy's chat history now sits behind a little round button, and a new Quiet phone button on the calendar shows when your phone will mute or vibrate.
Your buddy now keeps a chat log of what you've said to each other, with a little picture of him next to his messages, in a bigger bubble.
After an update, the app now shows which phone permissions got switched off, with one button that walks you through turning them all back on.
Your phone can go quiet during work and classes (Settings → Sounds → Quiet phone), and you can tell your buddy to mute or unmute it. Tap Install to get it.
New Birthdays, Work and Classes buttons under the calendar show everything coming up, soonest first. Classes get their own icon you can change in your theme.
Your own work and birthday icon pictures now have a size slider, and they no longer cover your mood on the calendar.
Work shifts now get a work icon on the calendar, and you can change it (and the birthday icon) to your own picture in your Calendar theme.
Fixed the big circle on the calendar. Days with a reminder now show a small dot under the date.
Reminders can have notes now: open a reminder to type them. The list only shows a small preview.
You can now send pictures to your buddy. Send him your work schedule and he puts your shifts on your calendar.
On your computer, Ctrl+F now finds words on the page, just like in a web browser.
Your buddy now says a different hello each time you tap him, including ones for the time of day.
Notes with titles now show before untitled ones, and reminder pop-ups on the computer no longer get cut off at the top.
Your buddies can have names now, and they remember them (set it in the theme editor or just tell him). New and restored reminders also slide in smoothly.
Checked reminders now fade out and the gap closes smoothly (and the other way when you uncheck), and the reminder trash bin plays your open, close and delete sounds.
Volume on this phone now goes up to 200%, so you can hear the app over music.
New Volume on this phone slider in Settings → Sounds and alerts. It only changes your phone, not your computer.
New trash button on Reminders: see reminders you deleted, then restore them or delete them for good.
The bottom buttons' pictures and icons now change to the color of the page you're on.
The Ditto widget now shows a purple number for reminders that are due, and it only goes away when you check them off. Tap Install to get it.
Ditto now shows on your notifications, and there's a new Ditto widget with no background you can put on your home screen. Tap Install to get it.
New Size slider for your corner buddy in the theme editor, so you can make him smaller or bigger.
The bottom buttons now use the font of the page you're on, just like their colors.
Theme sounds and pictures sync more reliably: one stuck file no longer blocks the rest, the app keeps checking while open, and the theme editor shows how many files are left.
Bottom button colors now follow the page you're on instead of staying on every page.
Your buddy plays his sound again when his answer comes in.
Themes can color their bottom button (button and icon/text colors). Each button keeps its own page theme's colors on every page.
New search bar at the top of the theme editor to find any option. Also fixes theme sections that were stacking inside each other.
Computer only: a Volume on this computer slider in Settings → Sounds and alerts that turns every app sound up or down.
New reminders, new groups and the Show completed bar now fade in on the Reminders page.
The reminder sound now lives in your Reminders theme (Sound effects → When a reminder is due) and plays on phone notifications too. Settings hides the color options your themes already set.
Sound folders can now be much bigger (150 MB per sound, 5 MB each), and the label shows if any didn't fit. Removed the note runner option from themes.
New Patch notes bubble next to Check for updates in Settings, showing what every update changed.
Each theme sound effect can now hold up to 100 sounds.
New switch under the corner buddy in themes: pause his GIF where he is instead of restarting it.
Each theme sound can now be a folder (or several files): a random one plays each time.
Notes themes are grouped by color (Blue Notes, Red Notes…) with their own open/close sounds that override the All Notes ones. Slide a note's top bar down to close it.
Checked-off one-time reminders now fade away after 5 seconds. Uncheck before then to keep it.
The + for a new reminder now plays your reminder open and close sounds.
Close the update pop-up with its X or swipe it away. New theme sounds: opening and leaving a page, and opening and closing a reminder.
Themes can now be made for one section (like Notes or Reminders) so they only show the options that work there. Settings → Themes has a Move all button for your page themes.
Each bottom button now keeps its own page's theme look (picture and font) on every page.
Themes can now have their own sound effects (buddy, reminders, notes and more), evened out to the same loudness with volume sliders.
Pick your reminder sound in Settings → Sounds and alerts. Reminders now also notify you with that sound when the app is closed (install the new phone app).
Fixes the odd gaps in calendar birthdays: after apostrophes, and between the cake and the name.
Your corner buddy no longer gets cut off on the sides and top when he moves.
Your corner buddy now stays on top of pop-up messages instead of fading behind them.
Weather widget: the day highs and lows no longer get cut off. Install the new phone app.
Weather widget: bigger text that spreads out to fill the whole widget. Install the new phone app.
Fixes the weather widget not loading after the font update. Install the new phone app.
Your weather widget now uses the font from your home page theme. Install the new phone app to get it.
Your own font files can now be up to 12 MB.
Themes now have two fonts: one for the app's own text and one for everything you type.
New note font: Pikmin.
Upload your own font file for notes in the theme editor.
Themes can now set a note font, bold note text, and pictures for the bottom buttons.
Notes open in the same color as their card, unless you pick another one in your theme.
Fixed: an open note's color no longer spreads to other pop-ups. The Settings color sliders are gone.
Pick the color each note opens in, separately from your note cards (theme editor, Open note colors).
Resize theme pictures, save notes without a title, and slide each note color to your own shade in Settings.
Install the new phone app: your widget buddy sits on the right of his chat and his GIF plays while it's open.
Checked reminders keep their check mark until 4 AM, with Undo. The calendar glides smoothly between months.
Your buddy now says so when Gemini Nano answered instead of Gemini.
Swipe the calendar and watch the next month slide in. Your widget buddy uses Gemini and tells you which AI answered.
Your widget buddy now sits bigger inside the coming-up card.
Birthdays on the calendar, swipe between months, and install the new phone app to ask your buddy right from the weather widget.
Close your buddy's bubble after asking and he keeps working, then tells you when he's done.
The settings search has an X to clear it.
Your phone now uses your Gemini key for smarter answers. Gemini Nano takes over when you're offline.
Notes now come in red, grey and cyan, and themes can put a picture behind open notes. Install the new phone app to give the weather widget your clock picture.
Notes now come in red, grey and cyan, and themes can put a picture behind open notes for each color.
Themes can now put pictures on note cards, one per note color, plus see-through or outline cards.
Calendar picture bubbles show the whole picture. The phone app uses less battery.
Uses far less CPU and graphics power, and pauses its moving decorations when you switch away or leave it alone for a minute.
New alarms start at full volume now. You can still turn on Start quiet and get louder per alarm.
The Windows title bar now matches your theme instead of being plain white.
Your PC buddy is a bit smaller now.
The bar at the top of every page is gone. Titles and buttons sit right on the page.
On the PC, your buddy now stands in the bottom-right corner, much bigger.
Pick any color for the page, cards and text (Settings → Look, or in a theme). Buddy GIFs play when you tap them. Swapped theme pictures sync again.
Pull down at the top of any page to refresh and sync. Phone and computer customizations now merge instead of overwriting each other.
Check for updates is now at the top of Settings. Tap your corner buddy to talk to the AI. Buddies can be GIFs.
Bigger Ditto icon with no background, and the bottom buttons float so pages aren't cut off.
New Ditto icon, and the weather now uses your real location.
